contentPattern.structure: two columns of checkmark-icon + statement paragraphs

suitableFor: 'Why choose X' benefit checklists laid out in two columns
checkmark-prefixed statement lists on a colored (brand) section background
trust/reasons-to-buy content where each line has a check icon
notSuitableFor: small icon + single CTA promo strips (use columns-cta)
plain multi-column heading+paragraph informational lists (use columns-coverage)
